## Which file to download / 下载哪个文件

**Windows**: download `PhoneRemote.exe` from **Assets** below and double-click it. Python is not needed. The "Source code" archives are not the program.

**Windows**：在下方 **Assets** 里下载 `PhoneRemote.exe`，双击运行，不需要安装 Python。"Source code" 压缩包不是程序本体。

**macOS**: there is no packaged app yet, so there is nothing to download here. Run it from source by following the [macOS steps in the README](https://github.com/chrisye96/phone-remote#running-it), and update with `git pull`.

**macOS**：目前没有打包好的应用，这里没有可下载的文件。请按 [README 里的 macOS 步骤](https://github.com/chrisye96/phone-remote/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#运行)从源码运行，更新时执行 `git pull`。
